description: Resolve a role term by searching job families, job titles, and focus tags TOGETHER in one call. Use this when you're unsure whether a term (e.g. "ML engineer", "mobile", "SRE") is a job family, a specific title, or a specialization — each result is tagged with its type and slug so you can feed the right one to the benchmark tools. REQUIRED arguments: searchText.

searchText.description: Role term to resolve across job families, titles, and focus tags.

name: search-role-terms
